prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [home, redesign] Stage Layout Generation Care Station: Redesign the waiting screen into a stage layout featuring live activity progress indicators and pet care tips while pet generation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Your Pet is Awakening", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true}}
1: [choose_path, redesign] Full Bleed Mascot Story Intro: Redesign the story screen into a full-bleed layout featuring an animated pet mascot welcoming new users.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:hero_mascot", "style": "playful"}]}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Card Layout Companion Selector: Redesign the pick_friend screen using interactive selection cards with styled companion previews.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Choose Your Companion", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "rounded"}]}}
3: [sign_in, redesign] Compact Account Sign-In View: Redesign the sign-in screen into a compact layout focusing on account persistence and pet data protection.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Save Your Companion's Progress", "body": "Sign in to ensure your pet is saved to your account and accessible across sessions without reset."}}
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Docking Ready Notification Stream: Add a completion notification option and dynamic time estimate banner to the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "We will notify you the moment your pet is ready to dock on your desktop."}}
5: [sign_in, copy] Account Sync & Pet Data Protection Notice: Update sign-in copy to explicitly inform users that signing in prevents pet data reset and links pets to their profile.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Secure Your Pet to Your Account", "body": "Signing in links your pet safely to your account profile so your companion is never lost when restarting."}}
6: [choose_path, layout] Centered Journey Path Cards: Switch the choose_path screen layout to a centered design with a step progress counter.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "centered", "show_step_counter": true, "headline": "Pick Your Companion's Path"}}
7: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Quality Guidance Banner: Display explicit lighting and clarity instructions on the photo upload screen.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use well-lit, clear front-facing photos for optimal custom pet generation."}}
8: [finish, copy] Desktop Controls & Visibility Guide Copy: Provide clear onboarding finish copy explaining system tray access and desktop companion visibility controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "body": "Look for your companion on screen. Use the system tray icon to hide, show, or control your pet anytime."}}
9: [adoption, incentive] First Companion Accessory Unlock Badge: Add an unlocked starter item badge component on the adoption certificate screen to celebrate completion.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Starter Accessory Unlocked!", "style": "playful"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the waiting screen layout while keeping progress and time estimates preserves its core job.
Redesigning the story screen with a mascot layout retains the pet introduction purpose.
Redesigning the pick_friend screen with selection cards maintains the pet selection job.
Redesigning the sign_in screen into a compact view preserves sign-in functionality.
Adding completion notifications and dynamic estimates to the waiting screen is permitted inside onboarding.
Updating sign-in copy to detail pet data protection is an allowed onboarding text change.
Changing choose_path layout and adding a progress counter is allowed inside onboarding.
Adding photo quality guidance text to the upload screen is permitted inside onboarding.
Updating home_intro copy to explain desktop controls is allowed as home_intro is part of onboarding.
Promoting an unlocked starter accessory in onboarding copy violates Rule 3 prohibiting mentions of gifts or free extras.
